construct: Postzygotic activating variants in GNAS impair intrinsic GTPase activity of Gs alpha, producing constitutive adenylyl cyclase activation and excess cAMP signaling in affected cell clones. The mosaic distribution produces patchy café-au-lait pigmentation, fibrous dysplasia, and autonomous endocrine hyperfunction such as precocious puberty.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Precocious puberty, jagged café-au-lait pigmentation, and polyostotic ground-glass fibrous dysplasia in a child with an unaffected family identify McCune-Albright syndrome from postzygotic activating GNAS mosaicism.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: NF1 can produce café-au-lait lesions and bone findings, but its pigment borders and skeletal lesions differ and it does not produce the classic autonomous precocious-puberty/fibrous-dysplasia triad.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The skin-skeletal-endocrine triad and sporadic mosaic pattern make McCune-Albright syndrome uniquely correct.
